page.notes: Greek titles are reproduced as far as legible; several accents and breathings are doubtful, especially in the first column. The brace in the middle column joins the entries "De miraculis auditis" and "Physiognomicorum" and governs the translator line "Incerto interprete." on the right. The right-column entries for the last two rows are partly illegible; the translator names in the last row are set against each other and may be misaligned.
